hardware: 64 GB200 GPUs; 16 nodes, one NVLink rack; same rack and checkpoint in every pair

statistics.caveat: Four predeclared matched run pairs, scored relative steps8-27 without slow-sample removal; pair-level t and paired Fieller intervals assume independent approximately normal run-pair means. Candidate selected before these acceptance pairs; failed or checkpoint-mismatched pairs are recorded and replaced.

memory_caveat: b28 compiler buffer assignments for GPU0 reserve 12,854,925,652 additional bytes (11.972082 GiB) in default device memory. This does not measure a runtime allocator peak. A separate historical b16 diagnostic measured 103.565529 to 115.537611 GiB peak default-allocator memory, excluding the collective allocator. Runtime peak memory has not been remeasured on b28.
timing_caveat: No additional GPU memory queries were executed during these b28 acceptance arms. All predefined scored samples were retained. Two coordinator failures before training are excluded; no training pair was replaced.
profile_scope: Two warmed steps on GPU0 per arm; compiler allocation totals are from the captured GPU0 program.
